raw.question: invoices that are still unpaid, with the customer

naive.question: invoices that are still unpaid, with the customer
naive.sql:
SELECT so.partner_id, r.name AS customer_name, COUNT(i.id) AS unpaid_invoices_count
FROM sale_order AS so
JOIN sale_order_line AS sol ON so.id = sol.order_id
JOIN account_move AS i ON sol.order_id = i.id
JOIN res_partner AS r ON so.partner_id = r.id
WHERE i.state = 'open' AND i.amount_residual > 0
GROUP BY so.partner_id, r.name

pq.question: invoices that are still unpaid, with the customer

    rp.name AS customer_name,
    ro.amount_total,
    ro.state
FROM 
    sale_order ro
JOIN 
    res_partner rp ON ro.partner_id = rp.id 
WHERE 
    ro.invoice_status = 'not_invoiced'
